title: Genesis 1:1 — seven words with a menorah of stars; et is the center
summary: Genesis 1:1 in English, transliteration and Hebrew, colour-coded word by word and numbered 1 to 7. The translators' word 'the' after 'In' is crossed out, and the added 'the' words are underlined. Below the numbers a menorah is drawn from small Stars of David, with its central stem under word 4, את (et).

text.text: In ~~the~~ beginning God created the heavens and the earth.
bereshit bara elohim et hashamayim v’et ha’aretz
בראשית ברא אלהים את השמים ואת הארץ׃

words.gloss: alef-tav (untranslated direct-object marker); word 4, the middle word

numbers.note: Genesis 1:1 has seven Hebrew words, numbered 1 to 7; את is word 4, the middle

pictures.description: A menorah (seven-branched lampstand) drawn with small blue Stars of David and slash/pipe characters: a straight central stem under word 4 and three curved branches on each side, with a base at the bottom. The seven branch tops line up under the seven numbered words.

keywords: God created the heavens and the earth
